title: CoreWeave exercises final option for ~120 MW at Core Scientific (~$2.0B)

sources.quote: The new contract with CoreWeave is expected to add approximately $2.0 billion in projected additional cumulative revenue over the hosting contract’s 12-year term to the $6.7 billion in projected cumulative revenue associated with previously announced contracts with CoreWeave, for a total of $8.7 billion.

explain: CoreWeave exercised its last option to rent about 120 more megawatts from Core Scientific, bringing its total to about 500 megawatts and adding roughly $2 billion of expected revenue over 12 years.
